_doc: PUBLIC synthetic sample of the recall-eval question set (recall-eval.mjs, recall-world.mjs): one world, 10 items, invented names and 555-01xx numbers. The scored held-out set, its generator and every item templated from real history live outside the repo (~/Documents/voiceai-evidence/recall-eval/heldout/); never add them here. history: kind call (status = placed, no status = scheduled), number (a contact's new number), email, reminder, promise; daysAgo + hour in tz, or inHours ahead. items: bucket is one of multi-session, temporal, update, abstention, open-items; expect lists the facts a correct answer states ({d-2} renders as that weekday and date); abstain marks a question about something that never happened.
